happening.text: You stand on the square at the top of Saltstair, with the chapel on one side and the inn on the other.
You reach the quay at the foot of the street.

objectives.hint: Down the main street from the square, all five flights of steps, to the stone quay at the water.
objectives.title: Go down to the quay

happening.text: The street is walked, square to quay.
